description:
We're looking for a full-time Data Engineer to build and scale the data platform behind the ION Factory OS: the pipelines, warehouse, and APIs that deliver customer manufacturing data and power ION Intelligence, built to be fast, reliable, and efficient. Every part, work order, inspection, and nonconformance in ION is data that our customers rely on to make production decisions, and increasingly, data that powers ION's AI.


You'll join the First Resonance team full-time in Los Angeles, CA (HQ in El Segundo) as a foundational member of our engineering team.


WHY THIS ROLE?

Our customers build rockets, satellites, eVTOLs, nuclear reactors, and robots. Their factories generate rich, highly structured data, and they want it out of the shop floor and into their analytics, their ERPs, and their decisions, fast and correct.

You'll own the pipelines and APIs that make that happen: the ION Data Connector that delivers customer data on a measured freshness schedule, the Data API that developers and partners build on, and the data foundation for ION Intelligence, our AI layer. This is core to our company objective of building an infinitely scalable intelligence fabric for the factory floor.


OUR STACK

 - Application: Python backend (SQLAlchemy, asynchronous background jobs), GraphQL API, and a Next.js / React / TypeScript frontend

 - Data: PostgreSQL as the system of record; Snowflake as our cloud data warehouse; Airflow-orchestrated pipelines; the ION Data Connector and Data API for customer data delivery

 - Infrastructure: AWS, including dedicated, isolated customer environments in AWS GovCloud; infrastructure as code

 - Delivery: CI/CD with automated testing (Pytest)

 - How we build: AI-native. Our engineers use Claude and other coding assistants every day to ship faster and with higher quality
   

RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

 - Own the Data Pipelines: Design, build, and operate the Airflow pipelines that move ION data to customers and internal consumers, with clear freshness targets, monitoring, and alerting when they slip.

 - Build the ION Data Connector and Data API: Deliver reliable, well-documented, secure ways for customers to get their manufacturing data into their warehouses, BI tools, and ERPs.

 - Model Manufacturing Data: Turn parts, bills of materials, work orders, procedures, inventory, quality, and nonconformance records into clean, versioned data models and snapshots that stay consistent as the product evolves.

 - Power ION Intelligence: Build the data foundation and context pipelines that feed ION's AI features, so models and agents work from accurate, current, permissioned data.

 - Make Data Trustworthy: Put validation, reconciliation, lineage, backfill, and access controls in place so customers can depend on what we deliver, including in isolated GovCloud environments.

 - Scale with the Platform: Partner with Platform and Product engineers on Postgres and warehouse performance, efficiency, schema changes, and event-driven designs so data scales cleanly with our customers.

 - Feed Back to Product: Work with our Forward-Deployed Engineers to turn repeated customer data needs into reusable, productized pipelines.
   

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - 3+ years building and operating production data systems as a data engineer, software engineer, or analytics engineer

 - Strong Python and SQL, with software-engineering discipline: testing, version control, code review, CI/CD

 - Production experience with Airflow (or Dagster / Prefect) orchestrating pipelines with real reliability expectations

 - Deep PostgreSQL experience: data modeling, query performance, change data capture or incremental extraction

 - Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar), including query performance tuning

 - Experience designing and shipping data APIs or data products that external users depend on

 - Sound judgment about data failure modes: idempotency, late or out-of-order data, schema evolution, reconciliation, and backfills

 - AWS experience (S3, RDS / Aurora, IAM, and related services)

 - AI-native workflow: you use coding assistants to move faster and raise quality

 - Clear written communication; you can explain a data model or a data incident to an engineer and to a customer
   

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience preparing data for LLM / AI applications (retrieval, embeddings, context pipelines, evaluation data)

 - Familiarity with dbt and event streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)

 - Experience improving the efficiency of data workloads (warehouse spend, query tuning, pipeline resource use)

 - Experience with GraphQL APIs and Python ORMs (SQLAlchemy)

 - Experience in AWS GovCloud or other compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ITAR)

 - Background in manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, PLM, MES, or quality data
   

BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Health Insurance; medical, vision, dental, & life insurance.

 - Paid Parental Leave.

 - Employee Stock Option Plan.

 - Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours.

 - Paid holidays, sick days.

 - Flexible Friday and PTO.

 - 401K.
   
   

First Resonance is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.



First Resonance participates in E-Verify. As part of our onboarding process, a new hire's Form I-9 information will be shared with the federal government to confirm they are authorized to work in the U.S.



Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.



First Resonance accelerates the speed and reliability of hardware development for companies manufacturing the next generation of hardware products. This includes space exploration, electric airplanes, autonomous vehicles, nuclear reactors, robotics, and more. We are a group of software, hardware, and manufacturing engineers that are bringing the best of modern UX and data science to an industry that has been overly rigid in its innovation. We are removing the barriers preventing radical advancement by providing tools to manufacturing engineers and operators to move information more freely, collaborate with their teams more easily, and use the power of data to predict problems and provide insights that result in better hardware quality and delivery.
